description: Replace the list of mailboxes a campaign sends from with exactly these (up to 300). Each must be a connected mailbox in this workspace, or it answers 404. One already on the list that was disconnected since may stay. An empty list means the campaign sends from none, never from all. On a running campaign, a change that adds to what it sends or to whom also needs the `send` permission, and makes the caller its approver. Through an API key an owner limited, the key's limits must cover the campaign, every mailbox it sends from and outreach, or it answers 403 with `details.scope` naming the limit. A change that only takes something out needs none of that.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: set_campaign_senders
title: Set a campaign's mailboxes
